g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud Vertex AI MLOps with Workbench, pipelines, a feature store and a private endpoint

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Data scientists reach their Workbench notebooks through Identity-Aware Proxy
Merging their change to main notifies Cloud Build
which builds the training image into Artifact Registry
and starts a Vertex AI pipeline on workers in the training subnet
The pipeline reads features from BigQuery and writes artifacts to Cloud Storage inside the perimeter
and registers the evaluated model in the Model Registry
An approved model version is deployed to the fraud endpoint
Claims handlers open a claim in the claims app
which calls the endpoint through its Private Service Connect address
The endpoint looks up the customer's features in the online store
and logs requests and responses to BigQuery for model monitoring
